r97_repair.p1_summary: Deferred ft_tool_build body can mutate pins at call time via split prefix/suffix printf -v; static contract and source-time Bash probe are structurally blind to this class.

r97_repair.fix_contract: Real builder source is written to a temp file and sourced in child Bash; ft::fetch, sha512sum, ft::die and ft::extract are replaced before invocation; ft::fetch rejects any URL that is not the official 5.5.0 URL before network access; sha512sum records the live pin expectation and emits an independent official digest so the real builder guard compares them; ft::die exits 73; ft::extract records the archive path and exits 74 without installing anything. Positive: the genuine ft_tool_build call reaches exactly FETCH:<official URL>, GUARD_EXPECT:<official SHA512>, EXTRACT:/mock/jena-offline.tgz with exit 74. Negatives: split-name prefix=FT_UPSTREAM_ printf -v mutants for URL, SHA512 and both simultaneously are injected only after ft_tool_build() { and each aborts with exit 73 before unauthorized fetch/extract with exact safe-abort traces; the static contract and source-time probe are asserted to stay blind to these mutants, which is why the execution layer is required.
